title: Reserve the Turks & Caicos Rosemary Beach Carriage House | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: The ultra comfortable Turks & Caicos Rosemary Beach Carriage House offers updated furnishings, easy access to the beach, and amazing amenities! Book now!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Lovingly cared for carriage house adjacent to tennis courts and boardwalk to the Eastern green beach walkover.

Come and enjoy this wonderful, cheerfully designed large carriage house that accommodates four comfortably. Decorated with bright citrus colors and flooded with light, when you vacation here you will truly feel you are at the beach.

There are two ultra comfortable king-sized beds, one in the main floor bedroom and another located upstairs in the loft bedroom that also has a small sitting area. The main living area is spacious and comfortable and the full kitchen is open and equipped with new stainless steel appliances. If you prefer to feel that you are staying in a well cared for vacation home rather than a rental property...then look no further.

There is a covered balcony off the living room which overlooks an open courtyard and the tennis courts - sit back and relax. At over 700 square feet this carriage house is a wonderful retreat at the beach.

This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season.
